extensions.description: Receives FHIR launch context (patient ID, FHIR server URL, access token) on inbound A2A messages and forwards it to MedAssist's MCP tools as canonical SHARP HTTP headers.

description: Clinical Decision Support Agent for healthcare professionals. Provides patient summaries, drug interaction checking, lab interpretation, clinical risk scoring, care gap identification, and guideline matching.
name: MedAssist

skills.description: Generate a complete clinical overview including demographics, conditions, medications, labs, vitals, allergies, immunizations, risk scores, and care gaps for a patient.
skills.name: Comprehensive Patient Review

skills.description: Evaluate medication safety by checking drug-drug interactions, allergy cross-reactivity, therapeutic duplications, and contraindications for a patient's current or proposed medications.
skills.name: Medication Safety Check

skills.description: Calculate and interpret clinical risk scores (CHA2DS2-VASc, HEART, Wells DVT/PE, ASCVD, CKD-EPI) based on patient data, automatically selecting applicable calculators.
skills.name: Clinical Risk Assessment

skills.description: Identify care gaps including overdue screenings, vaccination gaps, and condition-specific monitoring needs based on USPSTF and CDC guidelines.
skills.name: Preventive Care Recommendations
